newFindings.title: Duplicate decoded JSON keys could bypass field-uniqueness intent
newFindings.issue: JSON.parse materializes only one value for duplicate raw or escaped keys.
newFindings.correction: Scan decoded object keys before materialization and reject duplicate seed, escaped se\u0065d, and shadow payload probes.

newFindings.title: Selected direct concept evidence could be mislabeled ambient
newFindings.issue: Market-value evidence previously used an ambient frame even for selected direct content or format carriage.
newFindings.correction: Use typed semantic and selectedCarriage to distinguish selected content, selected form, background, and ambient conditions.

newFindings.title: Autonomous correction evidence invented a source-bearing update
newFindings.issue: An ambient event could be narrated as though an actor supplied an update.
newFindings.correction: Autonomous evidence names pre-choice activity and never invents a source-bearing action.

newFindings.title: Salience-selected ending blocks could reverse chronology
newFindings.issue: A route chain and appended last resorts could narrate earlier decisions after later decisions.
newFindings.correction: Build typed decision blocks, prevent chains from jumping intervening last resorts, and sort globally by accepted turn.

newFindings.title: Malformed completed state could render an empty analytic shell
newFindings.issue: The UI completion flag could reach conclusion rendering before state consistency was checked.
newFindings.correction: Validate before invoking either builder and render direct recovery copy without internal ledger detail.

newFindings.title: Static notebook URLs are always public
newFindings.issue: Product gating cannot provide access control for published static artifacts.
newFindings.correction: Specify completion as a product discovery gate only; static publications contain no played state.

newFindings.title: Generator-13 saves do not migrate under generator 14
newFindings.issue: Exact replay cannot be claimed across a changed generation model.
newFindings.correction: Reject with GENERATOR_VERSION_MISMATCH instead of silently replaying different authored state.

newFindings.title: Current and legacy local-slot updates are not atomic
newFindings.issue: Browser Storage exposes separate current-key and legacy-key writes/removals, so a failure can leave both or leave the current key after a clear attempt.
newFindings.correction: Keep deterministic current-key read priority and explicit partial-failure recovery copy; a future storage transaction design may close the residual.

newFindings.title: Status and dependency claims had drifted from current bytes
newFindings.issue: The status record carried stale source/test counts and a dependency pass bound to another package-lock digest.
newFindings.correction: Mechanically derive source/test/simulation metadata and mark dependency and route checks not run for current bytes.

newFindings.title: Repeated stable affordances were misclassified as Catalysis
newFindings.issue: Safety, repair, and locked-ideal actions intentionally repeat and should not be evaluated as incident-responsive literary variation.
newFindings.correction: Classify from typed availability and ethics tags, never label text.

newFindings.title: Afterimage selection lacked equal-tie and no-change boundaries
newFindings.issue: A deterministic strongest residue needed explicit proof at equal magnitude and when every post-close metric is unchanged.
newFindings.correction: Use normalized magnitude plus scenario/metric lexical ties and emit no room-afterimage for a valid zero-change state.

newFindings.title: Chronological prose still showed mechanical cadence and delayed the scene
newFindings.issue: The first rewrite could remain a uniform transition template and open with abstract causal summary rather than the public incident.
newFindings.correction: Use the actual scene act to order public disclosure atoms, typed route semantics to govern carriage language, and metric/direction-specific residue; no path hash selects near-synonyms.

newFindings.title: The after-summary could contradict its selected scene and expose its audit schema
newFindings.issue: A correction scene was paired with the scenario-entry unknown, while repeated evidence wrappers, causal route verbs, and split cost ledgers displaced the lived incident.
newFindings.correction: Build the opening only from the selected scene's public disclosure atoms, keep later decisions chronological rather than causal, and pack each sourced semantic atom and complete last-resort unit without exposing review vocabulary.
